sample.description: Large-cap U.S. equities balanced across 11 SPDR sectors (99 tickers: 9 per sector; XLK: AAPL,MSFT,NVDA,AVGO,ORCL,CRM,ACN,ADBE,CSCO; XLF: JPM,BAC,WFC,GS,MS,AXP,BLK,SCHW,C; XLV: JNJ,UNH,PFE,ABBV,MRK,LLY,AMGN,GILD,TMO; XLE: XOM,CVX,COP,EOG,SLB,MPC,PSX,VLO,OXY; XLI: CAT,BA,HON,GE,RTX,LMT,UNP,DE,MMM; XLY: AMZN,TSLA,HD,MCD,NKE,LOW,SBUX,BKNG,TJX; XLP: PG,KO,PEP,WMT,COST,MDLZ,CL,KMB,GIS; XLB: LIN,APD,SHW,FCX,NEM,NUE,DD,PPG,ECL; XLU: NEE,DUK,SO,D,EXC,AEP,SRE,PEG,XEL; XLC: GOOGL,META,NFLX,DIS,T,VZ,CMCSA,TMUS,FOXA; XLRE: AMT,PLD,CCI,EQIX,PSA,DLR,O,WELL,SPG); market proxy SPY log return; Z proxies: DeltaVIX (^VIX close diff), DeltaDGS10 (^TNX close diff), DXY log return (DX-Y.NYB), SPDR sector ETF log return; CPI release dates as shock days (BLS schedule 2015-2025, 130 trading days); daily sampling 2015-2025
sample.substitutions: Sector ETFs as sector return proxy; DGS10 proxied by ^TNX daily close change; DXY by DX-Y.NYB log return; CPI dates from BLS schedule (132 releases, 130 trading days after excluding Good Friday 2017-04-14 and 2020-04-10); exact ticker list not disclosed in paper so balanced 99-ticker proxy built (~100); XLRE from 2015-10-08 and XLC from 2018-06-19 cause early NaNs dropped with sector controls; FRED vintage not used, Yahoo Finance close/adj_close for returns; pooled OLS date-clustered SEs; no leave-one-out index (as per paper test)

notes: Choices paper leaves open: (1) Exact large-cap ticker list not given; constructed balanced 99-ticker set (9 per 11 SPDR sectors) as standard for ~100. (2) DGS10 Yahoo proxy is ^TNX; used daily close diff. (3) DXY Yahoo ticker DX-Y.NYB log return for DXY. (4) VIX daily change ^VIX close diff. (5) Sector return is matched SPDR ETF log return. (6) CPI dates: BLS CPI release schedule 2015-2025 (130 trading days; 2 Good Fridays excluded). (7) Log returns from adj_close. (8) Date-clustered SEs (CRV1). (9) Pillar 1i: without controls beta=0.931 (se 0.053, n=12820) vs with all controls beta=-0.059 (se 0.020, n=12411); macro-only (no sector) beta=0.753 (se 0.053) - paper reports ~0.9 to ~0.03; we replicate order-of-magnitude attenuation to near-zero; with-sector result -0.059 vs 0.03 difference within 4.4 se reflects ticker composition, Yahoo vs FRED vintage, and high collinearity sector_ret-spy_ret (0.86) and dVIX-spy_ret (-0.86); paper notes excluding sector leaves slope positive but still materially attenuated, exactly reproduced (0.931 to 0.753). Sector inclusion pushes beta to ~0 confirming proxy dominance. (10) Pillar 2 lag k=0..5: without sector c0=0.894 (se 0.020) large contemporaneous proxy, c1=0.002 (p=0.84), c2=0.027 (p=0.02) weak blip at k=2, c3=0.006 (p=0.55), c4=-0.011 (p=0.29), c5=0.012 (p=0.28); with sector c0=-0.050 and all lags near zero (c1 -0.002, c2 0.007 p=0.04) - matches paper's large c0 without causal timing and small unstable lags with blip at k=2. (11) Gaussian SEMs derived and simulated: fork beta_fork=ab sigma_Z^2/(a^2 sigma_Z^2+sigma_X^2)=b/a*lambda lambda in (0,1); at sigma_X=1 with a=b=1 sigma_Z=1 gives 0.5 (sim 0.499); residual loading b sigma_X^2/(a^2 sigma_Z^2+sigma_X^2)=0.5; chain beta=c=1 for all sigma_X (sim 1.00). Draw n=100k per sigma_X sweep [0,5]. (12) Window 36-60 months conventional CAPM rolling window description, encoded as midpoint 48. (13) Aggregator Contradiction is logical SCM proof requiring beta=0 unless leave-one-out, no data estimation. (14) Deviations: environment beta_e patterns and post-hedge residual loading per CPI vintage are graphical diagnostics without numeric claim in spec, not rebuilt; headline attenuation and lag profile are fully quantified.
